primitives.name: Wind-Affected Kick Trajectory
primitives.verbatim_quote: More care is necessary when the kick is against the wind, than when with it.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'v_w': 'm/s, wind velocity vector', 'v_k': 'm/s, kick velocity vector', 't': 's, time of flight', 'd': 'm, horizontal displacement'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear wind influence, constant kick velocity, negligible air resistance beyond wind.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When |v_w| > |v_k|, trajectory becomes unstable or inverted.

layer2.mapping: GSI computes conditional probability P(success|v_w, v_k), GSE simulates trajectory evolution.
layer2.telemetry: Kick accuracy deviation from expected arc.

primitives.name: Ball Condition Impact
primitives.verbatim_quote: There is much difference in kicking a dry, new ball, and a wet, heavy one, that has been used perhaps throughout the greater part of a game.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'m_b': 'kg, ball mass', 'c_d': 'dimensionless, drag coefficient', 'w': 'kg/m³, moisture content', 'E': 'J, energy loss per bounce'}
primitives.assumptions: Ball deformation and surface friction vary with moisture and usage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When w > 0.5 kg/m³, c_d increases significantly, reducing range.

layer2.mapping: GSI uses empirical ball degradation models; GSE predicts bounce behavior.
layer2.telemetry: Average kick distance variation across ball states.

primitives.name: Kicker Alignment Precision
primitives.verbatim_quote: PREPARING THE MATERIAL 97 As the ball is kicked from the ground the kicker should have his tce turned down and the eyes on the spot he wishes his toe to hit.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'θ': 'rad, alignment angle', 'σ_θ': 'rad, angular uncertainty', 'x_t': 'm, target position', 'x_k': 'm, kick point'}
primitives.assumptions: Kicker eye-to-target alignment is deterministic within noise bounds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When σ_θ > 0.1 rad, accuracy drops below 70% threshold.

layer2.mapping: GSI aligns visual targeting with spatial error models; GSE maps alignment to control inputs.
layer2.telemetry: Deviation from intended target in degrees.
